name: Stellar variability monitoring
question: Which stars most need additional time-series coverage to characterise their variability or oscillations?
authority: CLAUDE-ASTRO-BUILD-001 §7 Objective C / §19 asteroseismology readiness (synthetic programme declaration)

features.name: time_series_coverage_gap
features.rationale: Frequency resolution scales with total span; short baselines cannot resolve close modes.

features.name: observation_gap
features.rationale: Long gaps degrade the window function.

features.name: evidence_quality
features.rationale: Existing high-quality series make additional coverage more valuable, not less, because it can be combined.

features.name: relationship_support
features.rationale: Cluster members share age and composition, which raises the value of each oscillation measurement.
